_doc.what: Per-character authored ground shadows + collision bodies (FB-23, #185). Keyed by character kind id: 'pip' (the player) or an NPC sprite id (e.g. 'wren'). Written by the editor's Shadow tab (character target) and Collision tab (character target); read by GameScene via getCharacterShadow() / getCharacterCollision(). A kind with no entry (or no field) keeps the default — FB-21 feet-ellipse for shadow, the PLAYER_SIZE/NPC_SIZE feet-square for collision — so migrate one kind at a time with zero regression.

shadow.dx: shape CENTRE x offset from the sprite CENTRE, px
shadow.dy: shape CENTRE y offset from the sprite CENTRE, px (positive = down, toward the feet)

collision.what: A centre-referenced AABB body box that travels with the live sprite — the collider Pip/NPCs use instead of the full feet-square. Author it to hug the body.
collision.dx: box CENTRE x offset from the sprite CENTRE, px
collision.dy: box CENTRE y offset from the sprite CENTRE, px (positive = down)
